subject.title: [P0] Feishu connector: sequential queue deadlock + self-talk feedback loop under slow LLM

question: Should the remaining Feishu slow-run repair abort timed-out agent work, change Feishu queueing to feed gateway follow-up collection, or be split into narrower fixes owned by the related PRs?
rationale: Current source proves the self-echo subset is fixed on main but the timeout, backpressure, abort, and session-lock semantics are intentionally unresolved and can change existing channel behavior.

options.title: Land coordinated abort/backpressure policy
options.body: Define the desired queue timeout, abort, and follow-up behavior once, then require Feishu live proof and session-lock regression coverage before closing the issue.

options.title: Split into canonical narrower items
options.body: Move the remaining queue, session-lock, and autonomous-loop pieces into tracked canonical issues or PRs before closing the umbrella.

options.title: Accept timeout-only behavior
options.body: Treat the non-aborting 5 minute queue eviction as the intended compromise and close only after maintainers explicitly accept the background-task/session-state risk.

recommendation.title: Land coordinated abort/backpressure policy
recommendation.body: Define the desired queue timeout, abort, and follow-up behavior once, then require Feishu live proof and session-lock regression coverage before closing the issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The /btw lane history makes this person a strong routing candidate for queue-policy decisions that must preserve lane semantics.
